ACL Cables revenue up 26% 📈

ACL Cables PLC (ACL) made revenue of Rs 14.30 billion in the July to September 2026 quarter, 26% more than a year ago. Operating profit rose 13% to Rs 2.57 billion.

Profit for shareholders was Rs 1.47 billion, about the same as a year ago (down 1%). For the first six months, profit was Rs 3.31 billion, up 7%, and revenue was Rs 25.79 billion, up 22%.

Source: ACL interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/644_1794561150280.pdf
